Unique identifier for the knowledge domain succession ID of the approved review.

Filters items by a specific approval status.

 - PENDING_REVIEW: Item is pending review.
 - REJECTED: Item has been rejected.
 - APPROVED: Item has been approved.
When set to True, returns only the item keys.
Maximum page size is 100; default is 100.
For multiple pages; must be specified in each request for two pages per sheet.
Sort order for multi page requests; valid options are rank, rank desc, create_time, create_time desc.

query.description: The collection, or index, that the exchange is performed against.
Unique ID of the exchange item; overrides the collection_id filter value if supplied; defaults to empty, which disables this filter.

Filters the list for ratings in a specific review status; the default of UNSPECIFIED disables the filter.

 - UNSPECIFIED: Not a valid exchange rating value.
 - PENDING: Exchange rating is waiting to be inspected for approval or rejection.
 - COMPLETE: Exchange rating has been inspected and acted upon; no further action taken.
